# Examples — SDL 5.2 tables as data

All verbatim from the document XML (cell paragraphs split into list items).

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `bug-bars.yaml` | Appendix N security bug bar (server and client pivots, Critical→Low) and the Denial of Service (Server) Matrix (12 rows); Appendix M privacy bug bar (end-user and enterprise-administration scenarios) |
| `lob-and-agile-tables.yaml` | SDL-LOB phase/activity table, LOB risk level → service level, LOB pre-production finding severity, SDL-Agile bucket example (Table 1) |
| `agile-requirement-tables.yaml` | every row of Appendices P, Q, R (100 rows: title, Requirement/Recommendation, applicability to online services / managed / native code); validates against `schema/sdl-5-2.derived.schema.json#/$defs/AgileRequirementRow` |
